// @id CQ-AX-04
// @param label:string
// @param absencePredicates:strings
CALL {
  MATCH (x:Entity {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Activity {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Adjudication {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Assertion {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Assessment {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Association {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:CaptureAttempt {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Chunk {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:MechanismEvidenceContext {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Report {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:ReportItem {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:SourceLocator {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:SourceSnapshot {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
}
WITH x,
  EXISTS { (x)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(a:Assertion) WHERE a.predicate = $predicate AND a.recordedTo IS NULL } AS hasAnswer,
  EXISTS { (x)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(a:Assertion) WHERE a.predicate IN $absencePredicates AND a.polarity = 'POSITIVE' AND a.recordedTo IS NULL } AS measuredAbsent,
  COLLECT { MATCH (x)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(f:Assertion {predicate: 'FIELD_NOT_REPORTED'})
            WHERE f.valueString = $field AND f.recordedTo IS NULL RETURN f.uid } AS notReportedBy,
  COLLECT { MATCH (x)<-[:ASSESSES]-(act:Activity {activityKind: 'RESEARCH'}) RETURN act.uid } AS searchedBy,
  // R-09 / R-41: a CaptureAttempt (PARTIAL or FAILED) only ever means "blocked"; D11 property join on subjectUid
  COLLECT { MATCH (ca:CaptureAttempt {subjectUid: x.uid}) WHERE ca.outcome IN ['FAILED', 'PARTIAL']
            RETURN ca {.uid, .toolId, .outcome, .failureKind, .httpStatus, .attemptedAt} } AS blockedAttempts
RETURN x.uid AS subject, hasAnswer, measuredAbsent, notReportedBy, searchedBy, blockedAttempts,
       CASE WHEN hasAnswer THEN 'ANSWERED'
            WHEN measuredAbsent THEN 'MEASURED_ABSENT'
            WHEN size(notReportedBy) > 0 THEN 'NOT_REPORTED'
            WHEN size(blockedAttempts) > 0 THEN 'BLOCKED'
            WHEN size(searchedBy) > 0 THEN 'SEARCHED_NOTHING_FOUND'
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS emptyAnswerKind
temporalNotes: as-of: the packet's predicate on the assertions; `ca.attemptedAt <= $R` for the attempts.
bitemporal episode needed on: none.
evidenceNotes: trace: the FIELD_NOT_REPORTED Assertion cites the section read (or WHOLE_SNAPSHOT); "searched" cites the Activity; "blocked" cites the attempt (`requestDigest`, `responseHash`, `httpStatus`; no snapshot when the response was hashed and not kept).
notes: **Ruling: R-09** (with R-41). Read "not reported" through the FIELD_NOT_REPORTED branch, and read CaptureAttempt (PARTIAL or FAILED) only for "blocked". Drop EMPTY_RESULT. R-41 keeps CaptureAttempt for FAILED and PARTIAL attempts only. The final `CaptureOutcome` enum is `PARTIAL | FAILED`.

**How the question is answered now:** in full. Nothing is lost: an empty search is the RESEARCH Activity with no answer, and a capture that returned nothing is a COMPLETE snapshot with a FIELD_NOT_REPORTED Assertion, not an attempt record.

MATCH (c:Claim {uid: $claimUid})<-[:OCCURRENCE_OF]-(o:Assertion)
WHERE o.recordedTo IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(who:Entity)
OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:OCCURS_IN]->(w:MediaWork)
RETURN o.uid AS occurrence, who.uid AS asserterUid, who.name AS asserter, w.uid AS container, o.speechAct AS speechAct,
  o.basisKind AS basisKind, o.polarity AS polarity, o.status AS status, coalesce(o.validFrom, o.validObservedAt) AS statedAt,
  COLLECT { MATCH (o)-[e:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(l:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(s:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(src:Source)
            RETURN {role: e.role, origin: e.origin, locator: l.uid, selectorDigest: l.selectorDigest, retrievedAt: s.retrievedAt, uri: src.canonicalUri} } AS spans,
  COLLECT { MATCH (v:Assessment {assessmentKind: 'VETTING'})-[:ASSESSES]->(c) WHERE v.recordedTo IS NULL
            RETURN {vetting: v.uid, disposition: v.disposition} } AS vetting
ORDER BY occurrence
notes: every current occurrence of claim C with asserter, container, located spans (HAS_EVIDENCE role/origin -> locator -> snapshot -> source), date, speech act, basis and the current VETTING disposition
typed equivalent: assertion {about: {uid: <subject>, predicate}} filtered by occurrenceOf.uid = claim (spans, asserter, speech act, basis)

// @id Q-K-10#1
// assertions resting on a capture of a revised source, by mechanism (R-44): SNAPSHOT | REVISES | HAS_REVISION_STATUS
CALL () {
  MATCH (src:Source)-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]->(rev:SourceSnapshot)
  WHERE rev.revisionKind IN ['RETRACTION', 'EXPRESSION_OF_CONCERN', 'ERRATUM', 'WITHDRAWAL', 'CORRECTED_AND_REPUBLISHED']
  MATCH (src)-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]->(old:SourceSnapshot)-[:HAS_LOCATOR]->(loc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]-(a:Assertion)
  WHERE coalesce(old.observedAt, old.retrievedAt) < coalesce(rev.observedAt, rev.retrievedAt) AND a.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN 'SNAPSHOT' AS mechanism, src.canonicalUri AS source, null AS work, null AS notice, rev.revisionKind AS revisionKind,
         rev.publishedAt AS revisedAt, rev.retrievedAt AS learnedAt, null AS revisionRecord,
         a.uid AS assertion, a.predicate AS predicate, a.assertionKind AS assertionKind, loc.exact AS exact,
         true AS capturedBeforeRevision
  UNION
  // R-44 + R-43: an identified notice REVISES the work; the Source is a RENDITION_OF that work (no shared Identifier, R-42)
  MATCH (notice:Publication)-[rv:REVISES]->(pub:Publication)<-[ro:RENDITION_OF]-(src:Source)
  WHERE rv.recordedTo IS NULL AND ro.recordedTo IS NULL
    AND rv.revisionKind IN ['RETRACTION', 'EXPRESSION_OF_CONCERN', 'ERRATUM', 'WITHDRAWAL', 'CORRECTED_AND_REPUBLISHED']

// @id Q-K-15
// @param label:string
MATCH (x:$($label) {uid: $uid})<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(a:Assertion)-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(who)
WHERE a.recordedTo IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE {origin: 'DECLARED'}]->(loc:SourceLocator)
      <-[e:HAS_EVIDENCE {origin: 'VERIFIER_FOUND'}]-(adj:Adjudication)-[:ASSESSES]->(a)
WHERE adj.recordedTo IS NULL
WITH a, who, [v IN collect(e.independence) WHERE v IS NOT NULL] AS independence,
     [v IN collect(e.authority) WHERE v IS NOT NULL] AS authority
// R-15 / R-80: the authors of an asserting work (D3 AUTHORED_BY on a Publication; D9 APPEARS_IN {AUTHOR} on a MediaWork)
CALL (who) {
  OPTIONAL MATCH (au:Assertion {predicate: 'AUTHORED_BY'})-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(who)
  WHERE au.recordedTo IS NULL AND au.status <> 'REJECTED'
  OPTIONAL MATCH (au)-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(byline)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (person:Person)-[ap:APPEARS_IN]->(mw:MediaWork)
  WHERE mw = who AND ap.appearanceRole = 'AUTHOR' AND ap.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN [w IN collect(DISTINCT byline) + collect(DISTINCT person) WHERE w IS NOT NULL] AS authors
}
WITH a, who, independence, authority, authors,
     CASE WHEN who:Person OR who:Organization THEN [who] ELSE [] END + authors AS holders
// D7 interest episodes of the asserter and of each author (HOLDS_STAKE, RECEIVES_VALUE_FROM, HOLDS_ROLE; OWNS_BRAND)
CALL (holders) {
  UNWIND holders AS h
  OPTIONAL MATCH (h)-[st:HOLDS_STAKE]->(so:Organization) WHERE st.recordedTo IS NULL
  OPTIONAL MATCH (h)-[vt:RECEIVES_VALUE_FROM]->(vo:Organization) WHERE vt.recordedTo IS NULL
  OPTIONAL MATCH (h)-[rl:HOLDS_ROLE]->(ro:Organization) WHERE rl.recordedTo IS NULL
  OPTIONAL MATCH (h)-[ob:OWNS_BRAND]->(br:Brand) WHERE ob.recordedTo IS NULL
  WITH h,
       collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN st IS NULL THEN null ELSE {holder: h.uid, interest: 'HOLDS_STAKE', counterparty: so.name, kind: st.stakeKind,
               validFrom: st.validFrom, validTo: st.validTo, assertion: st.assertionUid} END) +
       collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN vt IS NULL THEN null ELSE {holder: h.uid, interest: 'RECEIVES_VALUE_FROM', counterparty: vo.name, kind: vt.valueKind,
               validFrom: vt.validFrom, validTo: vt.validTo, assertion: vt.assertionUid} END) +
       collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rl IS NULL THEN null ELSE {holder: h.uid, interest: 'HOLDS_ROLE', counterparty: ro.name, kind: rl.roleKind,
               validFrom: rl.validFrom, validTo: rl.validTo, assertion: rl.assertionUid} END) +
       collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ob IS NULL THEN null ELSE {holder: h.uid, interest: 'OWNS_BRAND', counterparty: br.name, kind: null,
               validFrom: ob.validFrom, validTo: ob.validTo, assertion: ob.assertionUid} END) AS rows
  UNWIND rows AS row
  RETURN collect(row) AS interests
}
RETURN a.uid AS assertion, a.predicate AS predicate, a.validFrom AS statedAt,
       [l IN labels(who) WHERE l <> 'Entity'][0] AS asserterKind, who.uid AS asserterUid, who.name AS asserter,
       [p IN authors | p.uid] AS authors, independence, authority, interests,
       size(authority) = 0 AS notYetVerified,
       size(independence) > 0 AND NOT 'INDEPENDENT' IN independence AS noIndependentSupport,
       'PROMOTIONAL' IN authority AS restsOnPromotional,
       size(interests) > 0 AS asserterOrAuthorHasInterest
ORDER BY noIndependentSupport DESC, notYetVerified

MATCH (r:Report {uid: $reportUid})

  RETURN 'ASSESSMENT' AS kind, s.uid AS uid, s.status AS state, s.recordedTo AS closedAt, null AS revision, null AS revisionRecord
  UNION
  MATCH (r)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(loc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(snap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(src:Source)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (src)-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]->(rev:SourceSnapshot)
  WHERE coalesce(rev.observedAt, rev.retrievedAt) > coalesce(snap.observedAt, snap.retrievedAt) AND rev.revisionKind IS NOT NULL
  RETURN 'LOCATOR' AS kind, loc.uid AS uid, null AS state, null AS closedAt, rev.revisionKind AS revision, null AS revisionRecord
  UNION
  // a cited Assertion whose own evidence rests on a Source with a later revised capture or a HAS_REVISION_STATUS flag
  MATCH (r)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(a:Assertion)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(snap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(src:Source)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (src)-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]->(rev:SourceSnapshot)
  WHERE coalesce(rev.observedAt, rev.retrievedAt) > coalesce(snap.observedAt, snap.retrievedAt) AND rev.revisionKind IS NOT NULL
  OPTIONAL MATCH (src)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(st:Assertion {predicate: 'HAS_REVISION_STATUS'}) WHERE st.recordedTo IS NULL
  WITH a, coalesce(rev.revisionKind, st.valueString) AS revision, CASE WHEN rev IS NULL THEN st.uid END AS revisionRecord
  WHERE revision IS NOT NULL
  RETURN DISTINCT 'ASSERTION_SOURCE' AS kind, a.uid AS uid, a.status AS state, a.recordedTo AS closedAt, revision, revisionRecord
  UNION
  // R-44 + R-43: a locator the Report cites, on a rendition of a Publication that an identified notice REVISES
  MATCH (r)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(loc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(src:Source)
        -[ro:RENDITION_OF]->(:Publication)<-[rv:REVISES]-(:Publication)
  WHERE ro.recordedTo IS NULL AND rv.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN DISTINCT 'LOCATOR_WORK' AS kind, loc.uid AS uid, null AS state, null AS closedAt, rv.revisionKind AS revision, rv.assertionUid AS revisionRecord
  UNION
  // R-44 + R-43: a cited Assertion whose evidence is on a rendition of a revised Publication
  MATCH (r)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(a:Assertion)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(src:Source)

  WHERE ro.recordedTo IS NULL AND rv.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN DISTINCT 'ASSERTION_WORK' AS kind, a.uid AS uid, a.status AS state, a.recordedTo AS closedAt, rv.revisionKind AS revision, rv.assertionUid AS revisionRecord

// @id Q-K-21
MATCH (c:Claim {uid: $claimUid})<-[:OCCURRENCE_OF]-(o:Assertion)
WHERE o.recordedTo IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->+(root:Assertion) WHERE NOT EXISTS { (root)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(:Assertion) }
WITH o, coalesce(root, o) AS primary
OPTIONAL MATCH (primary)-[:OCCURS_IN]->(container:MediaWork)              // D9: the container, one per occurrence (R-19)
MATCH (primary)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE {origin: 'DECLARED'}]->(loc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(src:Source)
// R-43: the RENDITION_OF work is a D9 MediaWork or a D3 Publication (asserted, recorded time only)
OPTIONAL MATCH (src)-[ro:RENDITION_OF]->(work)
WHERE (work:MediaWork OR work:Publication) AND ro.recordedTo IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (loc)<-[v:HAS_EVIDENCE {origin: 'VERIFIER_FOUND'}]-(adj:Adjudication)-[:ASSESSES]->(primary)
WHERE adj.recordedTo IS NULL
WITH o, primary, coalesce(container.uid, work.uid, src.uid) AS family,
     CASE WHEN container IS NOT NULL THEN 'OCCURS_IN' WHEN work IS NOT NULL THEN 'RENDITION_OF' ELSE 'SOURCE' END AS familyBasis,
     collect(v.independence) AS ind,
     CASE o.polarity WHEN 'POSITIVE' THEN 'SUPPORTS' WHEN 'NEGATIVE' THEN 'CONTRADICTS' ELSE 'QUALIFIES' END AS role
WITH role, o, primary, family, familyBasis, size(ind) > 0 AND all(i IN ind WHERE i = 'INDEPENDENT') AS independent
RETURN role, count(DISTINCT o) AS occurrences, count(DISTINCT family) AS distinctFamilies,
       count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN independent THEN family END) AS independentFamilies,
       collect(DISTINCT {occurrence: o.uid, primary: primary.uid, family: family, familyBasis: familyBasis,
                         retelling: o <> primary, independent: independent}) AS rows

An EVIDENCE_SYNTHESIS Assessment can still merge families the graph does not join (shared authors), now through the D3 `AUTHORED_BY` predicate (R-80).

MATCH (p:Protocol {uid: $protocolUid})-[he:HAS_EDITION]->(e:ProtocolEdition)
WHERE he.recordedFrom <= $asOf AND he.recordedTo IS NULL

      (aa)-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(author:Person|Organization)
WHERE aa.recordedTo IS NULL
CALL (author, he) {
  // (1) D7 interest episodes (R-78 Shape B): RoleEdgeProperties.roleKind, StakeEdgeProperties.stakeKind,
  //     ValueEdgeProperties.valueKind; an unbounded episode's observation date is the authorizing Assertion's validObservedAt
  MATCH (author)-[i:HOLDS_ROLE|HOLDS_STAKE|RECEIVES_VALUE_FROM]->(org:Organization)
  WHERE i.recordedTo IS NULL
    AND (i.validFrom IS NULL OR he.validTo IS NULL OR i.validFrom < he.validTo)
    AND (i.validTo IS NULL OR he.validFrom IS NULL OR he.validFrom < i.validTo)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (ia:Assertion {uid: i.assertionUid})
  RETURN org, type(i) AS interestType, coalesce(i.roleKind, i.stakeKind, i.valueKind) AS interestKind,
         i.validFrom AS validFrom, i.validTo AS validTo, ia.validObservedAt AS observedAt, i.assertionUid AS assertionUid,
         'POSITIVE' AS polarity
  UNION
  // (2) stated non-interests: NEGATIVE assertions authorize no episode
  MATCH (n:Assertion {polarity: 'NEGATIVE'})-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(author), (n)-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(org:Organization)
  WHERE n.predicate IN ['HOLDS_ROLE', 'HOLDS_STAKE', 'RECEIVES_VALUE_FROM'] AND n.recordedTo IS NULL

}

MATCH (occ)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE {role:'SUPPORTS'}]->(:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(osnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(osrc:Source)
WITH occ, p, w, collect(DISTINCT osrc) AS occSources, min(coalesce(osnap.publishedAt, osnap.observedAt)) AS snapT
WITH occ, p, w, occSources,
     CASE WHEN w IS NULL THEN snapT ELSE w.publishedAt END AS t,                    // R-19: T = MediaWork.publishedAt; snapshot only without a container
     CASE WHEN w IS NULL THEN null ELSE w.publishedAtPrecision END AS tPrecision,
     CASE WHEN w IS NULL THEN 'SNAPSHOT_FALLBACK' ELSE 'OCCURS_IN_MEDIAWORK' END AS tBasis
MATCH (p)-[r:HOLDS_ROLE|HOLDS_STAKE|RECEIVES_VALUE_FROM]->(o:Organization)
WHERE r.recordedTo IS NULL                                                          // current belief; pass $R for as-recorded
OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:PARENT_OF*0..2]-(o2:Organization)                              // group <-> member, holding <-> subsidiary
WITH occ, p, w, occSources, t, tPrecision, tBasis, r, o, collect(DISTINCT o2) AS orgSet
MATCH (ia:Assertion {uid: r.assertionUid})                                          // authorizing Assertion: TRACE and validObservedAt (OVERLAP)
OPTIONAL MATCH (occ)-[:HAS_SUBJECT|HAS_OBJECT]->(obj)                               // the recommended thing: subject (Attia: D4 Device) or object
OPTIONAL MATCH (b:Brand)<-[:OWNS_BRAND]-(ox:Organization) WHERE ox IN orgSet AND (obj)-[:BRANDED_AS]->(b)   // D6 Product -BRANDED_AS-> Brand
WITH occ, p, w, occSources, t, tPrecision, tBasis, r, o, ia,
     CASE WHEN obj IN orgSet THEN 'SAME_ORGANIZATION' WHEN b IS NOT NULL THEN 'SAME_PRODUCT_OR_BRAND' ELSE 'NOT_ESTABLISHED' END AS basisHint
// disclosure candidates: the holder's own interest Assertion (predicate = the edge type) or a DISCLOSES_INTEREST Assertion (R-82)
// whose locator sits in a rendition of the same work (R-19: Source -RENDITION_OF-> w); without a container, in the occurrence's own Source
OPTIONAL MATCH (da:Assertion)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(dsnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(dsrc:Source)
  WHERE (da)-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(o)
    AND ((da.predicate = type(r) AND (da)-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(p))
         OR (da.predicate = 'DISCLOSES_INTEREST' AND (da.polarity IS NULL OR da.polarity <> 'NEGATIVE')
             AND ((da)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(p) OR (w IS NOT NULL AND (da)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(w)))))
    AND ((w IS NULL AND dsrc IN occSources) OR (w IS NOT NULL AND (dsrc)-[:RENDITION_OF]->(w)))

     collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN da IS NOT NULL THEN {a: da.uid, predicate: da.predicate, rendition: dsrc.uid,
       renditionPublishedAt: dsnap.publishedAt, renditionObservedAt: dsnap.observedAt,
       timing: CASE WHEN dsnap.publishedAt IS NULL OR t IS NULL THEN 'TIMING_UNKNOWN'           // DISCLOSURE TIMING: archived copy judged on observedAt

OPTIONAL MATCH (occ)-[:HAS_SUBJECT|HAS_OBJECT]->(thing)                             // the recommended thing: subject or object

OPTIONAL MATCH (cra)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(ia:Assertion) WHERE ia.predicate IN ['HOLDS_ROLE','HOLDS_STAKE','RECEIVES_VALUE_FROM']

// $uid = X (a D6 Product or a D1 IngredientMaterial); $V = valid time; $R = recorded time (default now)
MATCH (x {uid: $uid}) WHERE x:Product OR x:IngredientMaterial
CALL (x) {
  // R-68 (D7 set): MANUFACTURES -> Product | IngredientMaterial; SUPPLIES_MATERIAL -> IngredientMaterial; DISTRIBUTES -> Product
  MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(x)
  WHERE a.predicate IN ['MANUFACTURES', 'SUPPLIES_MATERIAL', 'DISTRIBUTES']
  RETURN a
  UNION
  // R-68: CONTRACT_MANUFACTURES_FOR is Organization -> client Organization; the product is the qualifier product=<uid>
  MATCH (x)-[:BRANDED_AS]->(:Brand)<-[:OWNS_BRAND]-(:Organization)<-[:HAS_OBJECT]-(a:Assertion {predicate: 'CONTRACT_MANUFACTURES_FOR'})
  RETURN a
  UNION
  // R-68: MANUFACTURER_UNNAMED, the brand owner's statement that its makers are unnamed (an explicit unknown, never a node)
  MATCH (x)-[:BRANDED_AS]->(:Brand)<-[:OWNS_BRAND]-(:Organization)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(a:Assertion {predicate: 'MANUFACTURER_UNNAMED'})
  RETURN a
  UNION
  // R-68: a label's distributor / manufacturer line is the D6 typed edge NAMES_RESPONSIBLE_PARTY (its authorizing Assertion)
  MATCH (x)-[:HAS_VARIANT]->(:ProductVariant)-[:HAS_PACKAGE]->(:Package)-[:HAS_LABEL_VERSION]->(:LabelVersion)
        -[n:NAMES_RESPONSIBLE_PARTY]->(:Organization)
  WHERE n.recordedTo IS NULL
  MATCH (a:Assertion {uid: n.assertionUid})
  RETURN a
}
WITH x, a
WHERE a.recordedTo IS NULL
  AND (a.validFrom IS NULL OR a.validFrom <= $V) AND (a.validTo IS NULL OR $V < a.validTo)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(subj)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(obj)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(lv:LabelVersion)
WITH x, a, subj, obj, lv,
     [q IN coalesce(a.qualifiers, []) WHERE q STARTS WITH 'exclusivity=' OR q STARTS WITH 'buyer='
        OR q STARTS WITH 'manufacturingKind=' OR q STARTS WITH 'product='] AS roleQualifiers,
     [q IN coalesce(a.qualifiers, []) WHERE q STARTS WITH 'product='] AS productQualifiers
WHERE a.predicate <> 'CONTRACT_MANUFACTURES_FOR' OR size(productQualifiers) = 0
   OR any(q IN productQualifiers WHERE q STARTS WITH 'product=' + x.uid)

// @id Q-D8-13
// $ingredientUid = X (a D1 IngredientMaterial or ChemicalSubstance); $V = valid time; $R = recorded time

OPTIONAL MATCH (xm:IngredientMaterial)-[:REALIZES_SUBSTANCE]->(x)

        CASE WHEN x:IngredientMaterial THEN [x] ELSE realizers END AS materials

    WHERE pst.statusKind IN ['PATENT_EXPIRED', 'PATENT_LAPSED']
      AND (ps.validFrom IS NULL OR ps.validFrom <= $V) AND ps.recordedFrom <= $R AND (ps.recordedTo IS NULL OR $R < ps.recordedTo)

CALL (x, substances) {
  UNWIND [x] + substances AS subj

  WHERE r.recordedFrom <= $R AND (r.recordedTo IS NULL OR $R < r.recordedTo)

}

}

// @id Q-D8-18
// $targetUid = D5 Target T; $J = the person's jurisdiction; $V = valid time; $R = recorded time

WHERE ta.recordedTo IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (rec:RegulatoryRecord {recordFamily: 'ENFORCEMENT'})-[ec:CONCERNS]->(p)
WITH p, collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rec IS NOT NULL THEN {record: rec.recordNumber, kind: rec.recordKind, issuedAt: rec.issuedAt,
                                                        assertionUid: ec.assertionUid} END) AS enforcement
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_VARIANT]->(pv:ProductVariant)
WITH p, enforcement, collect(DISTINCT pv) AS variants
// R-73: lots of the product or of its variants carry recalls and lot-identified QualityResults
CALL (p, variants) {
  UNWIND [p] + variants AS lotTarget
  MATCH (lot:Lot)-[:LOT_OF]->(lotTarget)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (rr:RegulatoryRecord {recordKind: 'RECALL'})-[rc:CONCERNS]->(lot)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (q:QualityResult)-[qf:QUALITY_RESULT_FOR]->(lot)
    WHERE q.valueQualifier = 'NOT_DETECTED' OR q.percentOfLabelClaimStated < 50 OR q.statedVerdict = 'DOES_NOT_CONFORM'
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rr IS NOT NULL THEN {record: rr.recordNumber, lot: lot.lotCode, recallClass: rr.recallClass,
                                                          recallStatus: rr.recallStatus, assertionUid: rc.assertionUid} END) AS recalls,
         collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN q IS NOT NULL THEN {result: q.uid, lot: lot.lotCode, analyte: q.analyteVerbatim,
                                                         value: q.valueVerbatim, pctOfClaim: q.percentOfLabelClaimStated,
                                                         assertionUid: qf.assertionUid} END) AS failedLotTests
}
// R-73: survey rows that name no lot stay D1 predicates on the Product | ProductVariant
CALL (p, variants) {
  UNWIND [p] + variants AS sampled
  MATCH (sa:Assertion)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(sampled)
  WHERE sa.predicate IN ['CONTAINS_UNDECLARED_SUBSTANCE', 'MEASURED_CONTENT_IN_PRODUCT'] AND sa.recordedTo IS NULL
  MATCH (sa)-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(cs:ChemicalSubstance)
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT {predicate: sa.predicate, substance: cs.name, value: sa.valueNumber, unit: sa.unitCode,
                           qualifiers: sa.qualifiers, assertionUid: sa.uid}) AS surveyRows
}

OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[:REALIZES_SUBSTANCE]->(cs2:ChemicalSubstance)

                                                          lots: rec.lotCodesVerbatim, assertionUid: c.assertionUid} END) AS harmRecords

                THEN datetime.truncate(toLower(i.validToPrecision), i.validTo) = datetime.truncate(toLower(i.validToPrecision), T) ELSE false END THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN (i.validTo IS NOT NULL AND i.validTo <= T) OR (i.validFrom IS NOT NULL AND i.validFrom > T) THEN 'DISJOINT'

MATCH (c:Claim {uid: $claimUid})<-[:OCCURRENCE_OF]-(o:Assertion {assertionKind: 'CLAIM'})-[:OCCURS_IN]->(w:MediaWork)
WHERE o.recordedTo IS NULL
MATCH (o)-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(a)
WITH c, o, w, a,
     EXISTS { (o)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(:Assertion) } AS explicitRetelling,                       // R-21
     EXISTS { MATCH (fa:Assessment {assessmentKind: 'RETELLING_FIDELITY'})-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(o)

     w.republicationKind IS NOT NULL AS recut
WITH c, o, w, a, explicitRetelling, matchedRetelling, recut, NOT (explicitRetelling OR matchedRetelling OR recut) AS firstHand

       count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstHand THEN a END) AS independentAsserters,
       count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstHand THEN o END) AS firstHandOccurrences,

MATCH (f:Frontier {uid: $frontierUid})
MATCH (orig:Assertion)<-[:DERIVED_FROM]-(ret:Assertion {assertionKind: 'CLAIM'})-[:OCCURS_IN]->(w:MediaWork)
WHERE w.publishedAt >= datetime() - duration({months: 24}) AND ret.recordedTo IS NULL

               WHERE x = f OR EXISTS { (x)-[:ON_FRONTIER]->(f) } OR EXISTS { (x)<-[:INVOLVES]-(:Event)-[:ON_FRONTIER]->(f) } }

RETURN gds.graph.project('d9-retelling-' + $frontierUid, target, source, { relationshipProperties: { weight: weight } })

// @id Q-D10-08
// @param population:string
MATCH (t:Target {key: $targetKey})
CALL (t) {
  // means asserted to worsen T (D5 goal predicate), non-guideline speech acts
  MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_OBJECT]-(a:Assertion {predicate: 'WORSENS_TARGET'})-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(m)
  WHERE a.recordedAt <= $asOf AND (a.recordedTo IS NULL OR a.recordedTo > $asOf) AND ($validAt IS NULL OR ((a.validFrom IS NULL OR a.validFrom <= $validAt) AND (a.validTo IS NULL OR a.validTo > $validAt))) AND NOT coalesce(a.speechAct, 'STATES') IN ['CAUTIONS', 'RECOMMENDS']
  RETURN m, 'assertion' AS basis, a.uid AS uid, a.predicate AS detail, a.qualifiers AS scope, null AS certainty, COLLECT { MATCH (a)-[tev:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(tloc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(tsnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(tsrc:Source)
    RETURN {via: a.uid, role: tev.role, origin: tev.origin, selectorKind: tloc.selectorKind, exact: tloc.exact, page: tloc.page,
            startOffset: tloc.startOffset, contentHash: tsnap.contentHash, retrievedAt: tsnap.retrievedAt, uri: tsrc.canonicalUri} } AS trace
  UNION
  // BellLabs harm assessments about a means and the target
  MATCH (t)<-[:ASSESSES]-(s:Assessment {effectDirection: 'HARM'})-[:ASSESSES]->(m)
  WHERE m <> t AND s.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND s.recordedAt <= $asOf AND (s.recordedTo IS NULL OR s.recordedTo > $asOf)
  RETURN m, 'assessment' AS basis, s.uid AS uid, s.assessmentKind AS detail, s.facets AS scope,
         coalesce(s.certainty, s.verdict) AS certainty, COLLECT { MATCH (s)-[tev:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(tloc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(tsnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(tsrc:Source)
      RETURN {via: s.uid, role: tev.role, exact: tloc.exact, contentHash: tsnap.contentHash, uri: tsrc.canonicalUri} AS e
    UNION
    MATCH (s)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(tin:Assertion)-[tev:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(tloc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(tsnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(tsrc:Source)
      RETURN {via: tin.uid, role: tev.role, exact: tloc.exact, contentHash: tsnap.contentHash, uri: tsrc.canonicalUri} AS e } AS trace
  UNION
  // R-83 guideline branch: goal predicates with a guideline speech act (no RECOMMENDS_AGAINST -> Target)
  MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_OBJECT]-(a:Assertion)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(m)
  WHERE a.predicate IN ['WORSENS_TARGET', 'NO_EFFECT_ON_TARGET'] AND a.speechAct IN ['CAUTIONS', 'RECOMMENDS']
    AND a.recordedAt <= $asOf AND (a.recordedTo IS NULL OR a.recordedTo > $asOf) AND ($validAt IS NULL OR ((a.validFrom IS NULL OR a.validFrom <= $validAt) AND (a.validTo IS NULL OR a.validTo > $validAt)))
    AND ($population IS NULL OR any(q IN coalesce(a.qualifiers, []) WHERE q IN ['population:' + $population, 'population:UNSPECIFIED']))
  RETURN m, 'guideline' AS basis, a.uid AS uid, a.predicate + '/' + a.speechAct AS detail, a.qualifiers AS scope, null AS certainty,
         COLLECT { MATCH (a)-[tev:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(tloc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(tsnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(tsrc:Source)
    RETURN {via: a.uid, role: tev.role, origin: tev.origin, selectorKind: tloc.selectorKind, exact: tloc.exact, page: tloc.page,
            startOffset: tloc.startOffset, contentHash: tsnap.contentHash, retrievedAt: tsnap.retrievedAt, uri: tsrc.canonicalUri} } AS trace
  UNION
  // R-83 population guidance: USE_CONSTRAINED_IN on the means asserted to serve T
  MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_OBJECT]-(g:Assertion)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(m)
  WHERE g.predicate IN ['IMPROVES_TARGET', 'INTENDED_FOR_TARGET'] AND g.recordedAt <= $asOf AND (g.recordedTo IS NULL OR g.recordedTo > $asOf)
  WITH DISTINCT m
  MATCH (m)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(a:Assertion {predicate: 'USE_CONSTRAINED_IN'})-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(cond:Condition)
  WHERE a.speechAct IN ['CAUTIONS', 'RECOMMENDS'] AND a.recordedAt <= $asOf AND (a.recordedTo IS NULL OR a.recordedTo > $asOf) AND ($validAt IS NULL OR ((a.validFrom IS NULL OR a.validFrom <= $validAt) AND (a.validTo IS NULL OR a.validTo > $validAt)))
    AND ($population IS NULL OR any(q IN coalesce(a.qualifiers, []) WHERE q IN ['population:' + $population, 'population:UNSPECIFIED']))
  RETURN m, 'guidelinePopulation' AS basis, a.uid AS uid, cond.name AS detail, a.qualifiers AS scope, null AS certainty,
         COLLECT { MATCH (a)-[tev:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(tloc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(tsnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(tsrc:Source)
    RETURN {via: a.uid, role: tev.role, origin: tev.origin, selectorKind: tloc.selectorKind, exact: tloc.exact, page: tloc.page,
            startOffset: tloc.startOffset, contentHash: tsnap.contentHash, retrievedAt: tsnap.retrievedAt, uri: tsrc.canonicalUri} } AS trace
  UNION
  // D9 recommendations against a means for this goal (R-83: subject = means, goal = qualifier target:<key>)
  MATCH (a:Assertion {predicate: 'RECOMMENDS_AGAINST', speechAct: 'RECOMMENDS'})-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(m)
  WHERE ('target:' + t.key) IN coalesce(a.qualifiers, []) AND a.recordedAt <= $asOf AND (a.recordedTo IS NULL OR a.recordedTo > $asOf) AND ($validAt IS NULL OR ((a.validFrom IS NULL OR a.validFrom <= $validAt) AND (a.validTo IS NULL OR a.validTo > $validAt)))
  RETURN m, 'recommendedAgainst' AS basis, a.uid AS uid, a.predicate AS detail, a.qualifiers AS scope, null AS certainty,
         COLLECT { MATCH (a)-[tev:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(tloc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(tsnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(tsrc:Source)
    RETURN {via: a.uid, role: tev.role, origin: tev.origin, selectorKind: tloc.selectorKind, exact: tloc.exact, page: tloc.page,
            startOffset: tloc.startOffset, contentHash: tsnap.contentHash, retrievedAt: tsnap.retrievedAt, uri: tsrc.canonicalUri} } AS trace
  UNION
  // published BLOCKED rows whose report is about T
  MATCH (t)<-[:ASSESSES]-(r:Report)-[:HAS_ITEM]->(i:ReportItem {disposition: 'BLOCKED'})-[:ASSESSES]->(m)
  WHERE r.recordedAt <= $asOf AND (r.recordedTo IS NULL OR r.recordedTo > $asOf)
  MATCH (i)-[:BLOCKED_BY]->(b)
  RETURN m, 'publishedBlock' AS basis, b.uid AS uid, [lbl IN labels(b) WHERE NOT lbl IN ['Entity', 'Occurrence', 'InformationArtifact', 'EvidenceAssessment']][0] AS detail, null AS scope, null AS certainty,
         COLLECT { MATCH (b:UseConstraint)<-[:RESOLVES_TO_CONSTRAINT]-(tua:Assertion)-[tev:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(tloc:SourceLocator)
                         <-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(tsnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(tsrc:Source)
                   RETURN {via: tua.uid, role: tev.role, exact: tloc.exact, contentHash: tsnap.contentHash, uri: tsrc.canonicalUri} AS e
                   UNION
                   MATCH (b:Assessment)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(tua:Assertion)-[tev:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(tloc:SourceLocator)
                         <-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(tsnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(tsrc:Source)
                   RETURN {via: tua.uid, role: tev.role, exact: tloc.exact, contentHash: tsnap.contentHash, uri: tsrc.canonicalUri} AS e } AS trace
}
WITH m, basis, uid, detail, scope, certainty, trace WHERE size(trace) > 0
WITH m, collect({basis: basis, uid: uid, detail: detail, scope: scope, certainty: certainty, trace: trace}) AS reasons
RETURN [lbl IN labels(m) WHERE NOT lbl IN ['Entity', 'Occurrence', 'InformationArtifact', 'EvidenceAssessment']][0] AS meansKind, m.uid AS meansUid, m.name AS means, reasons, size(reasons) AS nReasons
ORDER BY nReasons DESC
LIMIT 100

// @id CQ-PV-05
// the holder of the record identifier (R-42: one holder per (scheme, issuer, value); several issuers give several holders)
MATCH (holder)-[hl:HAS_IDENTIFIER]->(:Identifier {scheme: $scheme, value: $value})
WHERE hl.recordedTo IS NULL
CALL (holder) {
  // R-43: the typed rendition grouping (Publication or MediaWork)
  MATCH (src:Source)-[ro:RENDITION_OF]->(holder) WHERE ro.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN src, 'RENDITION_OF' AS grouping
  UNION

  MATCH (holder)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(ha:Assertion)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(src:Source)
  WHERE ha.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN src, 'EVIDENCE_OF_ASSERTIONS' AS grouping
  UNION

  RETURN src, 'IDENTIFIER_HOLDER' AS grouping

CALL () {

  MATCH (notice:Publication)-[rv:REVISES]->(pub:Publication)<-[ro:RENDITION_OF]-(src:Source)
  WHERE rv.recordedTo IS NULL AND ro.recordedTo IS NULL
    AND rv.revisionKind IN ['RETRACTION', 'EXPRESSION_OF_CONCERN', 'ERRATUM', 'CORRECTED_AND_REPUBLISHED', 'WITHDRAWAL']
  RETURN pub.uid AS work, src, 'REVISES' AS mechanism, toString(rv.revisionKind) AS revisionKind, notice.uid AS notice,
         toString(notice.publicationKind) AS noticeKind, rv.assertionUid AS revisionRecord, rv.recordedFrom AS knownSince
  UNION
  // R-44 branch 2: status flag with no identified notice (kernel HAS_REVISION_STATUS, one per authority):
  // a flag on one rendition taints every current rendition of the same work
  MATCH (hs:Assertion {predicate: 'HAS_REVISION_STATUS'})-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(flagged:Source)
  WHERE hs.recordedTo IS NULL
    AND hs.valueString IN ['RETRACTION', 'EXPRESSION_OF_CONCERN', 'ERRATUM', 'CORRECTED_AND_REPUBLISHED', 'WITHDRAWAL']
  OPTIONAL MATCH (flagged)-[fro:RENDITION_OF]->(pub:Publication) WHERE fro.recordedTo IS NULL
  OPTIONAL MATCH (pub)<-[sro:RENDITION_OF]-(sibling:Source) WHERE sro.recordedTo IS NULL
  WITH hs, pub, flagged, collect(DISTINCT sibling) AS siblings
  WITH hs, pub, siblings + [flagged] AS renditions
  UNWIND renditions AS src
  WITH DISTINCT hs, pub, src
  RETURN pub.uid AS work, src, 'HAS_REVISION_STATUS' AS mechanism, hs.valueString AS revisionKind, null AS notice,
         null AS noticeKind, hs.uid AS revisionRecord, hs.recordedAt AS knownSince

MATCH (stim:Event {uid: $stimulusUid})

  WHERE inv.recordedTo IS NULL
    AND inv.role IN ['SPONSOR', 'APPLICANT', 'REGULATOR', 'INVESTOR', 'LEAD_INVESTOR', 'LENDER']
WITH stim, resp, p, collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN actor IS NULL THEN null
                                     ELSE {actor: actor.name, role: inv.role, assertion: inv.assertionUid} END) AS roleActors
// a regulator documented by a D8 record is read from the record (R-66)
OPTIONAL MATCH (resp)-[dr:DOCUMENTED_BY_RECORD]->(rec:RegulatoryRecord)-[ib:ISSUED_BY]->(regulator:Organization)
  WHERE dr.recordedTo IS NULL AND ib.recordedTo IS NULL
WITH stim, resp, p, roleActors,
     collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN regulator IS NULL THEN null
                      ELSE {actor: regulator.name, role: 'REGULATOR', record: rec.recordNumber, assertion: ib.assertionUid} END) AS recordActors
// a publisher's act (R-44): RETRACTION milestone EVENT_ABOUT a D3 Publication; publisher = asserter of the primary REVISES episode
OPTIONAL MATCH (resp)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(ab:Assertion {predicate: 'EVENT_ABOUT'})-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(work:Publication)<-[rv:REVISES]-(notice:Publication)
  WHERE resp.eventKind = 'RETRACTION' AND ab.recordedTo IS NULL AND rv.recordedTo IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (rva:Assertion {uid: rv.assertionUid})-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(reviser)
  WHERE NOT (rva)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(:Assertion)
WITH stim, resp, p, roleActors, recordActors,
     collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN reviser IS NULL THEN null
                      ELSE {actor: reviser.name, role: 'REVISES asserter (' + rv.revisionKind + ')', work: work.uid,
                            notice: notice.uid, venue: work.venueName, assertion: rva.uid} END) AS revisionActors
// market moves are attributed to their reporter, never to BellLabs
OPTIONAL MATCH (resp)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(mm:Assertion {predicate: 'REPORTED_MARKET_MOVE'})-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(reporter)
  WHERE mm.recordedTo IS NULL
WITH stim, resp, p, roleActors + recordActors + revisionActors AS actors,
     collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mm IS NULL THEN null
                      ELSE {move: mm.valueString, reportedBy: reporter.name, assertion: mm.uid} END) AS marketMoves
// T(link): each RESPONDS_TO hop's authorizing Assertion, its locator and its SUPPORT adjudication (R-22 gate)
CALL (p) {

                  verdict: adj.verdict}) AS linkTrace
}

CALL (resp) {
  OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(resp)
  WHERE a.uid IN [resp.timeAssertionUid, resp.announcementAssertionUid, resp.effectiveAssertionUid, resp.scheduleAssertionUid]

}

WITH e, a, who, src, coalesce(rootWho.uid, who.uid) AS origin, root

  WHERE dr.recordedTo IS NULL

     collect(DISTINCT src.sourceKind) AS sourceKinds, collect(DISTINCT src.genre) AS genres, count(dr) > 0 AS hasRecord,
     collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN root IS NULL THEN null ELSE {assertion: a.uid, derivedFrom: root.uid} END) AS relays,
     collect(DISTINCT a.uid) AS assertionUids

     hasRecord OR any(g IN genres WHERE g IN ['REGULATORY_FILING', 'REGULATORY_RECORD', 'RETRACTION_NOTICE']) AS authorityRecord
RETURN e.uid, e.eventKind, e.startedAt, size(origins) AS independentOrigins, size(asserters) AS asserters,

            WHEN size(origins) = 1 THEN 'single origin (the authority of record)' END AS gap
ORDER BY independentOrigins, e.startedAt DESC

MATCH (r:Report {uid: $answerUid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:WAS_GENERATED_BY]->(composer:Activity)
CALL (r) {
  MATCH (r)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->{1,3}(a:Assertion) RETURN a
  UNION
  MATCH (r)-[:HAS_ITEM]->(:ReportItem)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->{1,3}(a:Assertion) RETURN a
}
MATCH (a)-[ev:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(loc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(snap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(src:Source)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(who)
RETURN r.reportKind, r.policyVersion, r.ledgerDigest, composer.runId AS composedByRun,
       a.uid AS assertionUid, a.predicate, a.status, [lbl IN labels(who) WHERE NOT lbl IN ['Entity', 'Occurrence', 'InformationArtifact', 'EvidenceAssessment']][0] AS asserterKind, who.uid AS asserterUid,
       ev.role, ev.origin, loc.uid AS locatorUid, loc.selectorKind, loc.selectorDigest, loc.exact, loc.page,
       loc.startOffset, loc.endOffset, loc.mediaStartSeconds,
       snap.contentHash, snap.contentHashBasis, snap.retrievedAt, snap.storageUri, src.canonicalUri,
       COLLECT { MATCH (a)-[:WAS_GENERATED_BY]->(p:Activity) RETURN p.runId } AS producingRuns,
       COLLECT { MATCH (adj:Adjudication)-[:ASSESSES]->(a) WHERE adj.recordedTo IS NULL
                 OPTIONAL MATCH (adj)-[:WAS_GENERATED_BY]->(vrun:Activity)
                 RETURN adj {.adjudicationKind, .verdict, .policyOutcome, .judgeKind, .methodVersion,
                             verificationRun: vrun.runId, bundleDigest: vrun.bundleDigest,
                             reselectsSameSpan: EXISTS { MATCH (adj)-[e2:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(loc)
                                                         WHERE e2.expectedSelectedContentDigest = ev.expectedSelectedContentDigest }} } AS adjudications
ORDER BY assertionUid, ev.role
LIMIT 500

// @id P-02d
MATCH (x:Entity {uid: $uid})
CALL (x) {
  MATCH (x)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT|HAS_OBJECT]-(a:Assertion)
  WHERE (a.recordedAt > $R1 AND a.recordedAt <= $R2) OR (a.recordedTo > $R1 AND a.recordedTo <= $R2)
  RETURN 'ASSERTION' AS kind, a.uid AS uid, a.predicate AS what, a.recordedAt AS opened, a.recordedTo AS closed, a.supersedesUid AS basis
  UNION
  MATCH (x)<-[:ASSESSES]-(s:Assessment)
  WHERE (s.recordedAt > $R1 AND s.recordedAt <= $R2) OR (s.recordedTo > $R1 AND s.recordedTo <= $R2)
  RETURN 'ASSESSMENT' AS kind, s.uid AS uid, s.assessmentKind AS what, s.recordedAt AS opened, s.recordedTo AS closed, s.supersedesUid AS basis
  UNION
  MATCH (x)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT|HAS_OBJECT]-(:Assertion)<-[:ASSESSES]-(adj:Adjudication)
  WHERE (adj.recordedAt > $R1 AND adj.recordedAt <= $R2) OR (adj.recordedTo > $R1 AND adj.recordedTo <= $R2)
  RETURN 'ADJUDICATION' AS kind, adj.uid AS uid, adj.verdict AS what, adj.recordedAt AS opened, adj.recordedTo AS closed, adj.supersedesUid AS basis
  UNION
  MATCH (x)<-[:ASSESSES]-(rep:Report)
  WHERE rep.recordedAt > $R1 AND rep.recordedAt <= $R2
  RETURN 'REPORT' AS kind, rep.uid AS uid, rep.reportKind AS what, rep.recordedAt AS opened, rep.recordedTo AS closed, rep.supersedesUid AS basis
  UNION
  MATCH (x)-[e]-()
  WHERE e.assertionUid IS NOT NULL
    AND ((e.recordedFrom > $R1 AND e.recordedFrom <= $R2) OR (e.recordedTo > $R1 AND e.recordedTo <= $R2))
  RETURN 'EPISODE' AS kind, e.relationshipUid AS uid, type(e) AS what, e.recordedFrom AS opened, e.recordedTo AS closed, e.assertionUid AS basis
}

// @id P-07
MATCH (t:Target) WHERE t.key = $targetKey OR t.parentKey = $targetKey
CALL (t) {
  MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_OBJECT]-(a:Assertion)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(m)
  WHERE a.predicate IN ['WORSENS_TARGET', 'NO_EFFECT_ON_TARGET', 'MIXED_EFFECT_ON_TARGET']
    AND a.status IN ['ACCEPTED', 'DISPUTED'] AND a.recordedAt <= $asOf AND (a.recordedTo IS NULL OR a.recordedTo > $asOf)
    AND ($pop IS NULL OR any(q IN coalesce(a.qualifiers, []) WHERE q IN ['population:' + $pop, 'population:UNSPECIFIED']))
  RETURN m, 'ASSERTED_EFFECT' AS basis, a.uid AS uid, a.predicate + '/' + coalesce(a.speechAct, 'STATES') AS detail, a.qualifiers AS scope
  UNION
  MATCH (a:Assertion {speechAct: 'RECOMMENDS', predicate: 'RECOMMENDS_AGAINST'})-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(m)
  WHERE ('target:' + t.key) IN coalesce(a.qualifiers, []) AND a.recordedTo IS NULL AND a.status IN ['ACCEPTED', 'DISPUTED']
  RETURN m, 'RECOMMENDED_AGAINST' AS basis, a.uid AS uid, a.predicate AS detail, a.qualifiers AS scope
  UNION
  MATCH (t)<-[:ASSESSES]-(s:Assessment {effectDirection: 'HARM'})-[:ASSESSES]->(m)
  WHERE m <> t AND s.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND s.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN m, 'HARM_ASSESSMENT' AS basis, s.uid AS uid, coalesce(s.certainty, s.verdict) AS detail, s.facets AS scope
  UNION
  MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_OBJECT]-(g:Assertion)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(m)
  WHERE g.predicate IN ['IMPROVES_TARGET', 'INTENDED_FOR_TARGET'] AND g.recordedTo IS NULL
  MATCH (m)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(ua:Assertion)-[:RESOLVES_TO_CONSTRAINT]->(uc:UseConstraint)
  WHERE ua.recordedTo IS NULL AND ua.status IN ['ACCEPTED', 'DISPUTED']
    AND ($pop IS NULL OR $pop IN coalesce(uc.scopePopulations, []))
  RETURN m, 'USE_CONSTRAINT' AS basis, uc.uid AS uid, uc.constraintKind + ': ' + coalesce(uc.summary, '') AS detail, uc.scopePopulations AS scope
  UNION
  MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_OBJECT]-(g:Assertion)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(m)
  WHERE g.predicate IN ['IMPROVES_TARGET', 'INTENDED_FOR_TARGET'] AND g.recordedTo IS NULL
  MATCH (m)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(ae:Assertion {predicate: 'CAUSES_ADVERSE_EFFECT'})-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(cond:Condition)
  WHERE ae.recordedTo IS NULL AND ae.status IN ['ACCEPTED', 'DISPUTED']
  RETURN m, 'ADVERSE_EFFECT' AS basis, ae.uid AS uid, cond.name AS detail, ae.qualifiers AS scope
  UNION
  MATCH (t)<-[:ASSESSES]-(:Report)-[:HAS_ITEM]->(i:ReportItem {disposition: 'BLOCKED'})-[:ASSESSES]->(m)
  MATCH (i)-[:BLOCKED_BY]->(b)
  RETURN m, 'PUBLISHED_BLOCK' AS basis, b.uid AS uid, [lbl IN labels(b) WHERE NOT lbl IN ['Entity', 'Occurrence', 'InformationArtifact', 'EvidenceAssessment']][0] AS detail, null AS scope
}
WITH m, collect({basis: basis, uid: uid, detail: detail, scope: scope}) AS reasons
RETURN [lbl IN labels(m) WHERE NOT lbl IN ['Entity', 'Occurrence', 'InformationArtifact', 'EvidenceAssessment']][0] AS meansType, m.uid AS meansUid, m.name, reasons, size(reasons) AS nReasons
ORDER BY nReasons DESC
LIMIT 100

// @id P-12
MATCH (start:Entity {uid: $startUid})
CALL (start) {
  MATCH (start) WHERE start:ChemicalSubstance OR start:Intervention RETURN start AS c, 'self' AS via
  UNION
  MATCH (start)-[:HAS_ACTIVE_MOIETY]->(c:ChemicalSubstance) RETURN c, 'active-moiety' AS via
  UNION
  MATCH (start:IngredientMaterial)-[:REALIZES_SUBSTANCE]->(c:ChemicalSubstance) RETURN c, 'realizes' AS via
  UNION
  MATCH (start:IngredientMaterial)-[:REALIZES_SUBSTANCE]->(:ChemicalSubstance)-[:HAS_ACTIVE_MOIETY]->(c:ChemicalSubstance) RETURN c, 'realizes+moiety' AS via
  UNION
  MATCH (start:IngredientMaterial)-[mc:MATERIAL_CONTAINS]->(c:ChemicalSubstance) WHERE mc.recordedTo IS NULL RETURN c, 'contains' AS via
}
MATCH (c)-[am:AFFECTS_MECHANISM]->(m:Mechanism)
WHERE am.derivationRule STARTS WITH 'd2.affects-mechanism/' AND (NOT $humanOnly OR am.humanMeasured)
WITH start, c, via, am, m,
     COLLECT { UNWIND coalesce(am.derivedFromAssertionUids, []) AS au
               MATCH (a:Assertion {uid: au})-[:OBSERVED_IN_CONTEXT]->(ctx:MechanismEvidenceContext)
               RETURN {assertion: a.uid, organism: ctx.organism, setting: ctx.setting, compartment: ctx.compartmentOntologyId} } AS contexts
OPTIONAL CALL (m) {
  MATCH (b:Biomarker)-[rm:REFLECTS_MECHANISM]->(m) WHERE rm.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN b, 'reflects' AS hop2, rm.assertionUid AS hop2Assertion
  UNION
  MATCH (b:Biomarker)-[:HAS_ANALYTE]->(an)-[pi:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(m) WHERE pi.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN b, 'analyte-participates' AS hop2, pi.assertionUid AS hop2Assertion
}
RETURN start.uid AS startUid, via, c.uid AS modulatorUid, c.name AS modulator, m.uid AS mechanismUid, m.name AS mechanism,
       am.direction, am.bestBasis, am.humanMeasured, am.nHumanContexts, contexts,
       b.uid AS biomarkerUid, b.name AS biomarker, hop2, hop2Assertion,
       COLLECT { MATCH (od:OutcomeDefinition)-[:MEASURES]->(sm:Metric)-[:QUANTIFIES]->(b)
                 RETURN {outcomeDefinition: od.uid, metric: sm.uid, compartment: sm.systemOntologyId} } AS studyMetrics,
       COLLECT { MATCH (b)<-[:QUANTIFIES]-(tm:Metric)<-[mm:MEASURES_METRIC]-(t:LabTest)
                 WHERE mm.recordedTo IS NULL AND (mm.validTo IS NULL OR mm.validTo > $asOf)
                 OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[pw:PERFORMED_WITH_VERSION]->(av:AssayVersion) WHERE pw.recordedTo IS NULL
                 OPTIONAL MATCH (prod:Product)-[:DELIVERS]->(t)
                 RETURN {test: t.uid, testName: t.name, metric: tm.uid, compartment: tm.systemOntologyId,
                         assay: av.methodPrinciple, product: prod.uid, measuresAssertion: mm.assertionUid,
                         sameCompartmentAsFinding: tm.systemOntologyId IN [x IN contexts | x.compartment]} } AS tests
ORDER BY mechanism, biomarker
LIMIT 200
